address: Plaça de Pius XII 4, Barcelona, 08028, Spain
bio: This glamorous restaurant, part of the dining options available at the Grand Hyatt Barcelona, bears the hallmark of chef Dani García and follows the aesthetic look established by his brothers in Madrid, Marbella and Dubai. This spacious restaurant, with its elegant, urban steakhouse philosophy, combines the usual presence on the menu of its famous “yakipinchos” and premium red meats (different cuts and periods of aging) with other more local dishes, such as Butifarra de Perol croquettes, and vegetable-based specialities including delicious grilled avocado from Malaga. A live DJ makes an appearance on some evenings, along with a brunch at the weekend. You also have the option of taking home your own personalised knife!...
